pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition on adding consecutive positions within 30 seconds of an initial entry to prevent falling knife pyramiding during liquidity sweeps.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Zero order execution allowed within 15 minutes of high-impact macroeconomic news releases and without confirmed order-book imbalance confirmation.
profit_harvest_threshold: Aggressively secure green runs when floating profit touches +$15.00 using trailing micro-stops to protect gains from evaporating.
